title: Ambient metadata inference and compact release-fragment writer for onboarding
author: Sofia Martinez
description:
Summary: Add an ambient metadata inference pass to the onboarding pipeline and a compact 'release fragment' writer that emits small, stable changelog snippets for model releases. Motivation: curation and release authors currently manually create dense release notes when onboarding new model versions. For high-volume onboarding (hundreds of model variants per quarter) this creates reviewer fatigue and inconsistent fragment quality. The new components provide a lightweight inference layer that suggests hierarchical metadata (domain, task, inferred latency class, tokenization notes) and writes compact release fragments that downstream tools can assemble into full changelogs or short release blurbs for console UI.

What this changes: single continuous description below includes implementation notes, checklist, commit summary, changed areas, and review convo.

Design/behavior: - Ambient metadata inference: a two-stage heuristic + ML-backed scorer that runs as a post-upload hook. Stage 1: deterministic heuristics extract architecture hints (decoder/encoder-decoder, likely tokenizer type via name), weight-decay of layer counts, and tokenization marker heuristics. Stage 2: a small classifier (packed as a stable artifact under model-registry/tools/ambient-infer/) scores likely domain(s) and latency buckets given profiler samples. Inference runs with conservative defaults and is opt-out via model manifest flag "onboard.ambient_infer: false". - Release fragment writer: emits compact JSONL per-model-version containing: title, one-line blurb, key changes (bullet list up to 3), performance anchors (p50/p95 baseline), and metadata tags. Fragments are intentionally terse to support: console micro-blurbs, changelog rollups, and release-email drafters. Writer supports templates and produces deterministic output (seeded) so diffs are reviewer-friendly.

Checklist: - [x] Implement ambient inference module and unit tests - [x] Add safe opt-out flag and documentation section - [x] Implement compact release fragment writer and writer unit tests - [x] Integrate fragment writer as optional onboarding pipeline step - [x] Add e2e test that validates fragment output for two sample models - [x] Add CI linting and stable artifact packaging - [x] Add ops doc for enabling in Private deployments

Commits (high level): - feat(onboard): add ambient inference module and classifier artifact (6 commits) - feat(release-frag): compact release-fragment writer and template engine (3 commits) - test: e2e onboarding test harness for fragments (2 commits) - docs: onboarding.md additions and ops-runbook (1 commit) - ci: bump packaging job to publish ambient-infer artifact (1 commit)

Files/areas changed (high level): - model-registry/onboard/ambient_infer.py: core inference pass and heuristics - model-registry/tools/ambient_infer/classifier.pkl: bundled classifier artifact (binary checksum referenced in code) - model-registry/onboard/fragment_writer.py: release fragment generation and templating - model-registry/tests/test_ambient_infer.py: unit tests and fixtures - model-registry/tests/test_fragment_writer_e2e.py: e2e test that runs upload->fragment - docs/onboarding.md: new section "Ambient metadata inference" - docs/ops/private-deployments.md: opt-in instructions and artifact sync - ci/publish-artifacts.yaml: package artifact publishing step - examples/onboard-examples/mini-locale-manifest.yaml: example manifest showing opt-out flag

Design decisions and constraints: - Classifier artifact is intentionally small and frozen; we avoid rolling model training in this PR. Future work will add supervised retraining. - Conservative defaults: inferred tags are suggestions and flagged as "inferred:true" in the manifest so reviewers can explicitly accept or override. - Deterministic writer: fragment output is seeded using model version and manifest hash so reviewers see stable diffs across CI runs. - Privacy: ambient inference only uses uploaded manifest metadata and profiler summaries; no raw customer payloads are sent to external services. Private deployments keep classifier as a local artifact.

Review conversation (selected): - Evan Chen (reviewer): "High-level: this is a great UX win. Two asks: 1) can we make the classifier path fully optional in CI (skip heavy scoring on small PRs)? 2) document how the inferred latency buckets map to the runtime's cost model (for SRE)." - Sofia (author): "@Evan added a lightweight gate: CI respects ONBOARD_LIGHT=1 to skip classifier scoring (see ci/publish-artifacts.yaml). Latency-to-cost mapping added to docs/ops/private-deployments.md with a link to the runtime cost buckets."

- Priya Kapoor (reviewer): "Minor: fragment writer needs to fail gracefully when perf anchors are missing (e.g., perf not available for brand-new variants). Add a fallback to 'unknown' and reduce anchors to p50 only." - Sofia: "Addressed: fragment_writer now emits p50 and omits p95 when not present; tests updated."

- Jules Park (reviewer): "Security check: classifier artifact should be checksummed and signature-verified before loading in Private. Also please add a short note to the release blurb about opt-out compliance for regulated customers." - Sofia: "Added checksum verification and ops note; Private deploys can point to a local artifact repo."

CI and testing: - Unit tests: 32 tests added, coverage for new modules ~86% - E2E: onboarding example runs in the test harness producing stable fragment JSONL - CI: build matrix ran on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, all checks passed; artifact publish job was manually re-run once due to transient network failure and then passed.

Manual QA notes: - Tested with three sample models: 'mistral-lite-v1', 'rwkv-small-8k', and a private GPT-style pointer model. Fragments were concise and reviewer-editable. - Observed that deterministic seeding eliminated spurious diffs between CI runs in 90% of sampled runs.

Backward compatibility and migration: - No breaking changes to existing manifests; new fields are optional. - Default behavior is no-op unless onboarding pipeline toggles the fragment writer. - For teams that enable the automated path, we recommend a 2-week canary where inferred tags are only suggestions (not auto-accepted).

Release notes (for changelog generation): - Adds ambient metadata inference to onboarding pipeline (opt-out flag available) - Adds compact, deterministic release-fragment writer for model versions - Includes ops notes for Private deployments and artifact verification

Follow-ups and TODOs post-merge: - ENG-5092: schedule telemetry to measure reviewer override rate for inferred tags - ENG-5210: add supervised retraining pipeline for classifier with opt-in data collection - UX: wire fragment snippets into the Console model release micro-blurb UI - infra: add a signed artifact distribution endpoint for Private customers

Merge: Squash-merged into main. Merge commit: "squash: ambient metadata inference + release fragment writer".

If you want to review locally: checkout head branch feature/ambient-metadata-release-fragments, run `python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-test.txt && pytest model-registry/tests/test_fragment_writer_e2e.py` to reproduce the e2e sample.
